text:
anne (runtime): quick sync — seeing ~2x P99 increase on nightly after the kernel_v2 switch. opening thread to align on bench sanity checks and a small playbook for triage.

jordan (ml): can you paste the exact bench config + diff? is this offline harness or smoketest?

anne (runtime): smoketest -> nightly harness. config snippet:```yaml
model: redwood/gptx-7b
seq_len: 2048
batch_size: 1
kernel_candidate: kernel_v2
warmup_seconds: 30
measurement_seconds: 300
sample_strategy: uniform_seq_shape
quant: int8
```

sam (bench): quick thoughts: 30s warmup feels low for 2k seq; we usually do 60–120s for long-seq. also the harness currently samples seq shapes evenly which can overweight worst-case shapes.

maria (sre): also check for system noise — nightly backup windows and node maintenance ran during the window yesterday. CPU steal and GPU power capping can show up as tail spikes.

jordan (ml): hypothesis: kernel_v2's fused-attn path sometimes falls back to baseline for *specific* seq-shape tiling (128x2048 pattern) causing perf cliffs. if harness occasionally hits that tiling we get a bimodal latency distribution.

anne (runtime): reproduced locally with a minimal harness. log snippet:```
[2026-02-12 03:12:05] ATTEMPT kernel_v2 launch -> success
[2026-02-12 03:12:07] ATTN_KERNEL: using fused path
[2026-02-12 03:12:09] ATTN_KERNEL: fallback to baseline for seq_shape=128x2048 (tile_mismatch)
[2026-02-12 03:12:09] LATENCY request_id=12 p50=70ms p95=180ms p99=720ms
```

sam (bench): propose changes to harness and triage flow: 1) increase warmup to 90s for seq_len>=1024, 2) sample seq-shapes by production distribution (not uniform), 3) capture per-request kernel path tag and perf counters, 4) run 3 independent rolling runs and compare p50/p95/p99 deltas.

deploy-bot: nightly-bench finished for pool-us-west-2 (jobs: 18) — results uploaded to s3://redwood-ci/nightly/1959876543/results.json

maria (sre): add an alert / dashboard check: if p99 / p95 ratio > 3 for a run, mark as flaky and auto-open triage issue. also ensure bench nodes have pinned CPU governor and no cron jobs during run.

anne (runtime): action items: I will open an RFC follow-up PR with the harness changes (warmup 90s, production seq sampling, per-request kernel tag) and include a reproducible minimal script. assigning @sam and @jordan for validation + bisect steps. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

sam (bench): :thumbsup: I'll instrument the harness to emit `kernel_path` and perf counters, then run a bisect across recent kernel commits. will publish scripts + raw logs to the s3 path.

jordan (ml): I'll add a KV-cache stress test that cycles seq shapes frequently to exercise the fallback path deterministically and add it to regression suite.

anne (runtime): thanks — once PR is merged we run 3 rolling runs and if p99 still regresses we do kernel bisect + revert candidate. notes to include in playbook: how to interpret bimodal histograms, where to look (tile mismatch, nvlink sync stalls, fallback counts), and short checklist for ops.

maria (sre): i'll schedule a short 30-min sync after PR lands to walk through the checklist and dashboard thresholds.

anne (runtime): closing loop here — will post PR link and a short runbook.

sam (bench): adding: remember to include seed for input generation to keep runs reproducible.

jordan (ml): + add a small unit test that asserts kernel_v2 fallback rate < 0.1% for canonical shapes.

anne (runtime): perfect. thanks everyone.
